Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D.

[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

Excerpt of about 200 rows, customer ids replaced.

The 200 rows in `orii-sample.csv` come from the 22 Nov 2011 slice. The excerpt includes cancellations, a non-product code, a blank customer, a nonpositive price and a repeated invoice/product pair. Nonblank customer IDs have been replaced by consecutive integers starting at one. [Original UCI dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/502/online+retail+ii)
